_doc: LLM-as-judge prompts for the round-2 GPT stability and non-GPT evaluator comparison. The five variants are semantic paraphrases of the canonical prompt; they are used only for the GPT prompt-stability analysis (Section VI-C of the manuscript). The canonical prompt is used for all non-GPT generative evaluators. Confirm with the coauthor that `canonical` matches the prompt actually used in the round-1 Table III experiments before running.
schema_constraint: Respond ONLY with a single JSON object: {"score": <float in [-1, 1]>}. No prose, no explanation, no extra keys.
canonical: Provide a number between -1 and 1 denoting the semantic similarity score for given sentences A and B with precision 0.01. A score of 1 means the sentences are perfectly similar, -1 means they are opposites, and 0 indicates no correlation in meaning. Respond ONLY with a single JSON object of the form {"score": <float between -1 and 1>}.
repair: Your previous response was not valid JSON in the schema {"score": <float in [-1, 1]>}. Please respond again, this time with the JSON object only and nothing else.
